info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Ecommerce Cart Checkouts-v4-spec
info.description: This API allows businesses to retrieve a list of checkout sessions from the ecommerce cart. It facilitates access to valuable insights regarding customer purchases, including their selected items and transaction details. Typical consumers of this API include analytics teams, customer support staff, and ecommerce platforms looking to enhance user experience by tracking cart activity. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can optimize their checkout processes and improve customer satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve the checkout details for the cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current checkout details associated with the user's cart. Use this to display the summary of items, pricing, and any applicable discounts before proceeding to payment.

requestBody.description: Request body for the checkout operation, which includes the necessary details to process the cart checkout. This may contain items in the cart, payment information, and user identification details.

200.description: Checkout process completed successfully, returning updated cart details.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the checkout operation in the cart service. It is expected to be a string formatted as JSON.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.title: Checkout Response

status.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the checkout.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the checkout operation.

state.description: Current state of the checkout operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the checkout operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the checkout operation.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response from the checkout operation in the cart service.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the checkout entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the checkout entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains audit information for the checkout operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request. This value helps in understanding the performance of the checkout operation.
